name: Rich Mahogany

evidence.note: Boulton Center report: sold-out crowd on its feet; band plays rock, Billy Joel, reggae, disco, country.
June 2026 Brookwood Hall concert filled the whole lawn with fans.
Band site pitches itself as good songs, good vibes and a great party.

dancing.notes: A local party band with a big following. At a theater show the crowd stood the whole night, and outdoor shows pack the lawn, so freestyle dancing is common.

description: Six-piece Long Island party band formed in 2006 that mixes classic rock, Billy Joel, modern rock, reggae, disco and country covers; well known around Bay Shore, Brightwaters and Fire Island.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Ira's 'The Spot at Oaksale Yacht' is likely The Spot at the Oakdale Yacht Club (typo). Band site events page is outdated.
